# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 16 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 16 | **Condition:** moderately preserved

---

**16:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have not abandoned my lot in the congregation of deceit,

**16:2** and in the council of the hidden ones You have not placed my portion.

**16:3** But You have called me to Your grace and to Your forgiveness [...]

**16:4** and in the abundance of Your mercies to all who return to You.

**16:5** For You have not set my judgment in the council of the secret ones,

**16:6** and You have not stored up truth for the way of the wicked.

**16:7** I know that You have chosen me for [...] and that no one misled by wicked lips shall stray from Your way.

**16:8** I know that in Your hand is the fashioning of every spirit, and its activity You established

**16:9** before You created it. How can anyone alter Your words?

**16:10** You alone created the righteous one, and from the womb You established him

**16:11** for the appointed time of favor, to be kept in Your covenant and to walk in all Your ways,

**16:12** and to [...] upon him in the abundance of Your mercies, and to open all the anguish of his soul

**16:13** to eternal salvation and everlasting peace without lack. You have raised his glory

**16:14** above flesh.

**16:15** But the wicked You created for the time of Your wrath, and from the womb You set them apart

**16:16** for the day of slaughter. For they walk in a way that is not good,

**16:17** and they have rejected Your covenant, and their soul has loathed Your truth.

**16:18** They took no delight in all You commanded, and they chose what You hate.

**16:19** According to the mysteries of Your understanding You have [...] all their retribution

**16:20** for Your judgments, to execute judgment upon them before all Your works,

**16:21** that they may be a sign and a portent for everlasting ages, so that all may know Your glory

**16:22** and Your great power. What then is flesh, that it should have insight into these things?

**16:23** How does a vessel of clay understand wonders? He dwells in iniquity from the womb,

**16:24** and until old age in the guilt of faithlessness. I know

**16:25** that righteousness does not belong to a mortal, nor the perfect way to any son of man.

**16:26** To God Most High belong all works of righteousness, and the way of a mortal is not established

**16:27** except by the spirit God has formed for him, to perfect a way for the sons of men,

**16:28** that all His works may know the power of His might and the abundance of His mercies

**16:29** upon all the children of His favor.

**16:30** As for me, dread of You has seized me, and trembling and shaking have gripped me,

**16:31** and all my bones declare [...] and my heart has melted like wax before fire,

**16:32** and my knees [...] for I remember my guilt and the faithlessness of my fathers.

**16:33** The wicked rose against Your covenant, and the worthless against Your word.

**16:34** I said: On account of my transgression I am abandoned far from Your covenant.

**16:35** But when I remember the power of Your hand and the multitude of Your mercies, I rise.

**16:36** I stand, and my spirit holds firm against the blow, for I lean upon Your covenant-faithfulness

**16:37** and the abundance of Your mercies, for You atone for iniquity and purify a mortal from guilt by Your righteousness.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 16 closely parallels Column 11 in its final section while introducing explicit double-predestination theology. SOPHIA adopted EMET's "congregation of deceit." "Covenant-faithfulness" per project convention. "Day of slaughter" from EMET retained. See disagreement log for 7 divergences.*
